aboutGame.title: What is Lost and Found Co?
paragraphs: Lost and Found Co. is a cozy hidden object adventure from Bit Egg Inc. You play as Ducky, a duck transformed into a human intern, and help the fading goddess Mei run a lost-property business in Plumville. Each case sends you through hand-drawn, layered scenes to recover missing objects, solve small puzzles, and uncover the stories behind the town's residents.

The campaign spans 11 story chapters and more than 15 stages, with requests, optional objectives, hidden Juju, and a room you can decorate with furniture from Kit's shop. Post-launch updates have added new stages and localization, while a Switch and Switch 2 release is planned for early 2027.

modules.name: Lost and Found Co Walkthrough
modules.description: Follow the story campaign from the first case to the final chapter with a practical search method, stage-order advice, and cleanup routes for stubborn objectives.

highlights.detail: Click a HUD objective for a free hint before searching the room.
Scan skyline and hanging props first, then shelves and counters, then floor clutter.
Open signs, drawers, boxes, trays, and prop edges before rechecking the whole scene.
Zoom in on tiny targets and pan across packed areas instead of clicking blind.
Save Juju hints for the last stubborn object or the last unsearched zone.
Replay stages for optional objectives and achievements while the layout is fresh.

modules.name: Lost and Found Co Beginner Guide
modules.description: Learn the core hidden-object loop, objective types, search habits, and early progression tips that make the first chapters much smoother.

highlights.detail: Clear HUD objectives first because they are the required path and provide free hints.
Search one zone at a time instead of clicking randomly across the whole scene.
Treat an Obscured clue as a prompt to open the nearest interactive prop.
Follow Quest chains until the target list stops changing.
Collect Juju early, but spend their hints late.
Return after the story to clean up optional goals and stage achievements.

items.question: What is Lost and Found Co?
items.answer: Lost and Found Co is a cozy hidden object adventure from Bit Egg Inc. You play as Ducky, a duck transformed into a human intern, and help the goddess Mei recover lost items for the residents of Plumville.

items.question: How many chapters does Lost and Found Co have?
items.answer: Lost and Found Co has 11 story chapters and more than 15 hidden-object stages. Requests, optional objectives, and post-launch stages add more content beyond the main campaign.

items.question: How long does Lost and Found Co take to beat?
items.answer: Lost and Found Co takes about 8.5 hours for the main story, around 13 hours for the main story plus side objectives, and about 18 hours for a completionist run.

items.question: How do Juju work in Lost and Found Co?
items.answer: Juju in Lost and Found Co are hidden helpers disguised as ordinary objects with grey, wobbly outlines. Catching one grants extra hints that are best saved for the last stubborn target in a stage.

items.question: How many achievements does Lost and Found Co have?
items.answer: Lost and Found Co has 31 Steam achievements. Most are tied to completing story stages, request stages, optional objectives, and full stage cleanups.

items.question: Which platforms is Lost and Found Co available on?
items.answer: Lost and Found Co is available on PC through Steam and is Steam Deck Verified. Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 versions are planned for early 2027.
